human_feedback: generally correct. other notes, for neows blessing if u have the option to lose starting relic for boss relic go for it. in combat, unless u have lethal, its always good to block first before attacking, unless the damage difference is higher, eg u deal alot of damage with ur cards compared to taking from the enemy, while ur hp is still healthy. and yes dont be stingy with ur potion usage, if the potion can potentially reduce damage taken in the combat, u should use it as potions can be found quite easily.

taking a boss relic over starting relic is better actually. yes u should recover when low hp. one other thing i noticed u defended when the enemy had no intent on attacking. if the enemy has no intent on attacking u do not need to defend, maximise damage

1) healing over smithing before boss or elite is always better. 
2) option to give up starting relic for boss relic is always the choice
3) u need to know what kind of deck u are going for within the first few card choices, then commit. common deck builds would be strength build eg demon form and rupture and cards that consume hp; status deck aka fire breathing with wild strikes and cards that put a status card into ur deck; exhaust deck
4) need to better manage hp
against the guardian, if hes in defensive mode, try not to hit him unless u have block or the damage is worth it. managing hp during combat is crucial
